_note: Part of the ten-hour repurposing batch ORCH-REPURPOSING-10H-20261021. Adjacent and transferable literature: every paper that is not WWOX evidence is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE, at class level, no dose, no paediatric suitability presumed, not medical advice.
OBJECTIVE: Roadmap P4 for the BENEFICIO_PRECOCE path, from the repository's own qualified records and with no new literature reading unless one panel decides a card: the first candidate cards or explicit abstentions with framework/scripts/repurposing_bridge.py, using the R4 design tables as the evaluation frame (what a WOREE evaluation must measure and what it cannot claim).

SCOPE.outputs: disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/cards_early/ (new subdirectory, yours alone) with a README; do NOT write into cards/, which scientist-a owns for the deep-recovery path

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: every card carries the roadmap's P4 fields, UNKNOWN rather than absent
a card for an axis with no support is an explicit abstention naming the missing datum
an early-benefit card names the ONE endpoint it pursues and keeps symptomatic benefit apart from disease modification
no score, no ranking, no probability, no dose, no paediatric suitability
time to access and time to benefit separate
DELIVERABLE: manifests, staged receipt JSONs, commit candidates, analysis note, self-eval
